items: In a saucepan over low heat, melt butterscotch chips and butter; cool for 10 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, beat eggs, brown sugar and vanilla. Add butterscotch mixture; mix well.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add to batter and mix well.
Stir in marshmallows, chocolate chips and nuts.
Spread into a greased 13x9-inch baking pan. Bake at 325°F for 25-30 minutes or until brownies test done with a toothpick.
